formattedAddress: No. 10號, Lane 19, Section 1, Da'an Rd, Guangwu Village, Da’an District, Taipei City, Taiwan 106

displayName.text: 十二月 粥品 • 茶飲 • 私房菜｜台北大安店

text.text:
It was full house, but we sat down for a meal as the staff called to confirm with someone but did not pick up the call (great service)

Went in December And the chicken porridge was amazing and so comforting for the cold weather. The texture is the mushy kind which I love, similar to hongkong congee.  Flavour is terrific, chicken has the sesame oil frangrance and so tender.

The 青龙菜 is great but taste slightly different than Singapore, I think probably it's due to the water being used. Maybe spring water from the mountains.

Ordered the fried chicken also and it's close to 咕噜肉 or orange chicken, fantastic as well

text.text: We ordered chicken porridge, crab porridge, yam with duck, egg tofu, and a vegetable dish. We did not like the crab porridge. It came with a small crab and it was frustrating to eat as we had to pick out the crab meat. On top of it, there were shells in porridge and parts of it tasted bitter. We liked everything else so I would still recommend this restaurant.

text.text: Tried the garlic stir fried beef and crab porridge- both dishes delivered on flavor. The beef was fragrant and nicely seasoned, while the porridge had a rich, comforting depth with fresh crab. Slightly on the pricier side for what you get, but if you’re looking for a satisfying meal that leans toward indulgence, it’s worth considering.

text.text: Just happened to walk by this place, so we decided to stop in and have dinner. There are a couple of vegan congee options. You have to order at the counter. Service was good.
